_doc: Labelled posts for live_incident.py (owner 2026-10-22). now = 2026-10-22T14:00:00Z; each post was published minutes_ago before it. truth.live: by the spec, a security incident happening now (or started within 60 min of publication) AND still inside the window at 'now'; truth.pin: where it is, only when the TEXT states the place unambiguously (name, lat, lon, tol_km), else null. A shown pin is CORRECT only when truth.live and truth.pin and within tol_km. prod=true: a real production text of 2026-10-22 (shortened). Labels are the engineer's reading; two readers may differ on the borderline ones (note).
